function: CSI feedback compression: autoencoder whose latent vector is quantized by a trainable vector-quantization module with entropy coding, reconstructing the CSI at the BS (p. 1-3).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO downlink, BS ULA Nt=32 antennas, single-antenna UE, OFDM with Nc=1024 subcarriers; no RIS; 5.3 GHz indoor and 300 MHz outdoor (p. 1-2, 4).
method: Vector-quantized variational autoencoder (CNN-I, CNN-II) with trainable codebook, rate-distortion loss and Huffman coding; unsupervised end-to-end offline training; bit clipping and multi-codebook strategies (p. 2-4).
data_channel: COST2100 channel model, indoor picocellular 5.3 GHz and outdoor rural 300 MHz; 100000 training, 30000 validation, 20000 inference samples; ULA Nt=32, 32 delay taps, Nc=1024 (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training, validation and inference splits (100000/30000/20000) of the same COST2100 data, results reported separately for indoor and outdoor; no unseen scenario, band or antenna count tested (p. 4).
baselines: Learned only: original VQ-VAE [12], entropy-coded VQ-VAE, PQB with non-uniform SQ [8], entropy-coded uniform/static SQ autoencoders [14], [15]; no non-learned baseline (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE in dB, cosine similarity, average feedback bits, and entropy-coded bits against the theoretical entropy limit (p. 4-5).
complexity: none; only the qualitative remark that CNN-II has more parameters and FLOPs than CNN-I, with no numbers (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "the COST2100 channel model for the indoor picocellular scenario" at 5.3 GHz and the outdoor rural scenario at 300 MHz [17]; training and inference data both come from it.
q2_support: p. 4: "the training, validation, and inference sets are 100000, 30000, and" 20000: held-out splits of the same COST2100 data; re-training or fine-tuning for a changed channel distribution is only mentioned (p. 3), never tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "the quantization-aware DL-based CSI feedback methods developed" in [8], [14], [15] are the baselines, with VQ-VAE [12]: all are learned, and no non-learned method (e.g., compressed sensing or codebook feedback) is compared.
q4_support: p. 5: "has a larger number of parameters and FLOPs compared to CNN-I" is only qualitative; no parameter count, FLOPs or runtime is given (Table I lists NMSE, cosine similarity and average bits).
q5_support: p. 4: "The channel dataset is generated by" the COST2100 model, so the authors generate their own data; no code or data link, DOI or statement of a public dataset appears in the paper.
notes: Included, area 2 (CSI feedback compression). The UE has a single antenna but the BS has Nt=32, so the system rule does not exclude it. q1 met by COST 2100. q5 is 0 because the data are generated by the authors with no link and no public-dataset statement; the reviewer may confirm whether this COST2100 set counts as public.
